description: Return the latest stored public report for one domain: score from 0 to 100, profile (mail, null_mx or no_mx), per-protocol findings, and Remediation.packs with the DNS records to publish. BIMI is reported but does not change the score. Use this to read a report or to poll after assess_domain; use get_summary for figures across all domains instead. If the domain has not been checked yet, or the check is still running, it returns HTTP 404 JSON with error not_found. In that case call assess_domain and poll again. Public reports expire after 24 hours.

domain.description: Registrable domain name without scheme, path or port, for example example.com.
